name: Me and You
source:
After years of self-doubt, you are finally ready to confess to Sayori. All the feelings you harbor, all the pain you feel… With a few words they become both of your burdens. Are you ready to connect to Sayori in ways deeper than you can imagine? Are you ready to truly love someone? Are you ready to accept every flaw and burden that comes with that?

[From the [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/DDLCMods/comments/ro3qbk/me_and_you_full_release1112/]announcement on Reddit[/url]]
